description: This file defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) entity in a wireless communication stack, specifically for the transmission (TX) side. It includes class declarations for notifiers and interfaces used by lower and upper layers to handle PDCP PDUs, control, and status notifications, as well as security configuration.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the lower layers about new PDUs and discard requests in the TX direction.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for informing the PDCP about transmit and delivery status notifications from lower layers.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_data_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layers to pass SDUs into the PDCP TX entity.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for configuring security, recovery, re-establishment, and buffering in the PDCP TX entity.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers about protocol failures, max count reached, and resume requirements.
